title: 五点不再等的提醒
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. FIRST PERSON POV close-up, landscape 16:9, delicately painted semi-realistic visual-novel CG. Show ONLY the adult male holder's hands with washed blue denim jacket cuffs holding one plain black smartphone. No face, no head, no body portrait, no person beyond the hands. Viewer shares the phone owner's viewpoint, looking down at the phone front. Palm supports the back, fingers curl around side edges, the front display has only a tiny earpiece, no rear camera array. The display has exactly two reminder rows: "17:00" with grey off switch, and "今晚工作" with green on switch. Readable Chinese, no dates, app brands or extra text. The old five-o-clock reminder is off, tonight's work reminder remains active. In shallow-focus background, use reference 1 old internet-cafe counter doorway materials, with one plain cup from reference 3 already placed inside a cabinet. Reference 2 establishes the single black phone and denim cuff only, never copy the multi-object board. Bright natural daylight, restrained mood. Hands and phone in the upper central two-thirds, natural table/denim continuation below. No Huang Qiuqiu, no second person, no floating UI, no captions or watermark.

shot.title: 五点不再等的提醒
